text: For #438, as #449 built it: until a running Codex card has a completed reasoning item or a turn.completed event, it shows Pending, explained as reported when the run ends, with no numeric thinking count or legend, and the live JSON marks it thinkingPending, since Codex reports reasoning_output_tokens only as a turn completes. A completed reasoning item clears Pending and shows the existing estimate, zero included. A whole turn.completed clears it too, and its reported count replaces any estimate, as before. Pending also clears when the agent or step ends, and once cleared, later turns, sessions, rereads and trimmed marks in that transcript never restore it. Claude Code's streamed count shows no Pending.
